description: 2014 Ford Mustang GT Premium 5.0 For Sale in "Oxford White!"  Rare Glass Roof  401A Premium Plus  Red Leather  Boss 302 Intake Manifold  WE FINANCE   Some Mustangs stand out because of what was added later. This one stood out before it ever left the factory.  Finished in Oxford White over Red leather, this 2014 Ford Mustang GT Premium 5.0 was special ordered new with an unusually strong list of factory equipmentbut there's one option sitting overhead that immediately separates it from almost every other S197 Mustang you'll come across.  The factory Glass Roof.  Add the 401A Premium Plus Package, Electronics Package with Navigation, Comfort Package, heated seats, rearview camera and Reverse Sensing & Security Package, and somebody clearly wasn't ordering the cheapest GT Premium on the lot.  They were ordering their Mustang.  And since then, somebody made it even better.   Look Up.  Of all the options available on the late S197 Mustang, few change the character of the car quite like the factory Glass Roof.  And you simply don't see many of them.  More than 33,000 Mustang GT coupes were built for 2014. Reported Ford production data shows only 1,918 were equipped with the Glass Roof.  From outside, the dark panoramic glass creates an incredible contrast against the Oxford White bodywork. From inside, it completely transforms the cabin, giving the Mustang an open, airy feel without turning it into a convertible.  It's subtle enough that someone walking past might not immediately notice it.  Mustang people will.  And this one didn't stop with the roof.  Add 401A Premium Plus, Red leather, Electronics Package with Navigation, Comfort Package, rearview camera and Reverse Sensing & Security, and you begin to understand just how unusually this Mustang was ordered.  Somebody knew exactly what they wanted.   Somebody Checked the Boxes.  The Glass Roof might be the headline, but the rest of the original order is what makes this Mustang especially interesting.  The 401A Premium Plus Package gave the GT Premium one of its more desirable interior configurations, and against Oxford White, the Red leather is exactly the kind of color combination that makes an otherwise familiar Mustang memorable.  Then somebody kept checking boxes.  Factory Options & Equipment Include:   	Factory Glass Roof 	401A Premium Plus Package 	Red Leather Interior 	Electronics Package with Navigation 	Rear View Camera 	Reverse Sensing & Security Package 	Comfort Package 	Heated Seats 	5.0L Coyote V8 	Automatic Transmission   It's a specification that makes considerably more sense once you know the car was special ordered new.  Somebody knew exactly what they wanted.   Tasteful Modifications. Done Right.  Fortunately, the modifications follow the same theme as the original specification.  Under the hood, the factory 5.0L Coyote V8 has been upgraded with a Ford Racing Boss 302 Intake Manifold, Airaid Performance Air Intake, aFe Power Cat-Back Exhaust System and performance tuning.  The Boss 302 manifold is especially appropriate here. Rather than changing the basic personality of the Coyote, it leans into one of the things the engine already does exceptionally wellrev.  The intake, exhaust and tuning complement the manifold rather than feeling like a random collection of bolt-ons.  Modifications Include:   	Ford Racing Boss 302 Intake Manifold 	Airaid Performance Air Intake 	aFe Power Cat-Back Exhaust System 	Performance Tuning 	Ford Racing Blue Coil Pack Covers 	BMR Strut Tower Brace 	SVE 19" GT350R Replica Wheels in Gloss Black 	MGP Red Brake Caliper Covers 	Black 5.0 Fender Emblems 	Tinted Sidemarker Lights 	Tinted Windows   The gloss black SVE wheels and black exterior accents work especially well against Oxford White, while the red caliper covers subtly tie back into that Red leather interior.  Nothing about it overwhelms the car.  It's still very clearly a Mustang GT. Just a better-looking, better-breathing version of one.   The Sweet Spot of the S197.  There's a reason the 2013-2014 Mustang GT has developed such a loyal following.  You get the unmistakable styling of the final S197, the 5.0L Coyote V8, and an interior that still feels refreshingly straightforward compared with what came afterward.  It's modern enough to drive regularly.  Old-school enough to still feel like a Mustang.  And this particular example adds something most of them simply don't have.  Look up.  That huge piece of glass overhead is a constant reminder that this wasn't just another GT Premium pulled from dealer inventory.  Between the Glass Roof, 401A, Red leather, Electronics Package and the rest of its original equipment, the interesting part of this Mustang existed long before the modifications began.  The upgrades simply add another layer.   Clean History. Special Order.  This Mustang also carries a Clean Carfax, giving the next owner the kind of history we want to see behind a uniquely configured car like this.  More importantly, it has retained the combination that made it interesting from the beginning:  Oxford White. Red leather. 401A. And that Glass Roof.  You can add wheels to another Mustang. Available at Johnson Motors of St. Croix Falls, this Trax combines practical SUV versatility with Chevrolets efficient turbocharged powertrain, a comfortable interior, and smart technology that makes everyday driving easier.  Under the hood, youll find a 1.4L turbocharged 4-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering a responsive driving experience while maintaining the practicality that makes the Trax such a popular compact SUV. The Trax also features front-wheel drive, power steering, StabiliTrak stability control, traction control, and 4-wheel anti-lock disc/drum braking, giving you a confident setup for daily commuting, errands, road trips, and everything in between.  Inside, the Trax is designed with versatility in mind. The bucket seats are finished in cloth, with a 6-way power drivers seat and adjustable lumbar support to help you get comfortable behind the wheel. The 60/40 split-folding rear seatbacks provide additional flexibility when you need room for passengers, groceries, gear, or larger cargo. Theres also a fold-flat front passenger seat, multiple storage areas, cupholders, a center armrest, and convenient cargo storage beneath the rear floor.  The driver-focused cabin includes a 3-spoke steering wheel with audio controls, an easy-to-read instrument cluster with digital speedometer, trip computer and fuel information, plus a 4.2-inch monochrome Chevrolet MyLink display. The technology package includes Bluetooth connectivity, AM/FM radio, auxiliary audio input, MP3 capability, and a 6-speaker audio system, making it easy to stay connected and enjoy your music on the road.  Backing into tight spaces is easier thanks to the rearview camera, while available OnStar/telematics functionality and a Wi-Fi hotspot add another layer of connectivity and convenience. Automatic headlights, daytime running lights, intermittent wipers, heated rear glass, power mirrors, power windows, power door locks, and remote keyless entry round out the everyday features.  The exterior combines the practical footprint of a compact SUV with useful features including 16-inch steel wheels, all-season tires, a temporary spare tire, body-color door handles, automatic headlights, rear defrost, and daytime running lights. Roof-mounted features and four cargo tie-downs help make the Trax adaptable for everyday hauling and weekend adventures.  Safety is another important part of the Trax package. Features include front, side-impact, and head-curtain airbags, a driver knee airbag, passenger airbag sensing, three-point seat belts, seat-belt pretensioners, child safety locks, and the LATCH child-seat system. Traction control, stability control, and antilock braking provide additional driver assistance.  This Bravo Warranty vehicle offers the added benefit of warranty coverage, giving you additional confidence as you put miles on your next vehicle.  If youre looking for a versatile, easy-to-drive compact SUV with turbocharged power, flexible cargo space, modern connectivity, a rearview camera, and a strong selection of convenience and safety features, this Chevrolet Trax deserves a closer look. description: Toyota Certified Pre-Owned | 2022 Toyota Highlander XLE | The V6 with Dual Injection: Why This Engine Earned a 200,000-Mile Reputation | 63,000 Miles 63,000 Miles | Blueprint over Black SofTex | Stock #T541986 | Toyota Certified Pre-Owned | Three Rows, Power Moonroof, Heated Seats, Blind Spot Monitor  Ask a technician why the Highlander's 3.5-liter V6 has the reputation it has, and the answer is a detail most buyers never hear about. Toyota's D-4S system runs two sets of fuel injectors, one spraying into the intake port and one directly into the cylinder. Direct injection alone gives you power and efficiency but lets carbon build up on the intake valves over the years, which is the expensive cleaning job that catches owners of other direct-injected engines around 80,000 miles. The port injectors on this engine keep washing those valves clean. Add a timing chain instead of a belt and a diet of regular unleaded, and you have the reason a 2022 Highlander XLE at 63,000 miles is closer to the beginning of its life than the middle.  That engine makes 295 horsepower through an eight-speed automatic and is rated to tow 5,000 pounds. It is also the last generation of the Highlander to offer a V6 at all; from 2023 on, the gas Highlander moved to a turbocharged four-cylinder. Ask us to confirm the drivetrain on this specific unit before you compare fuel economy figures; both front- and all-wheel-drive versions carry the same engine and the same tow rating.  XLE is the trim where the Highlander starts to feel like a Lexus without the price. SofTex seating with a heated, eight-way power driver's seat, a power tilt-and-slide moonroof, a hands-free power liftgate, roof rails, three-zone automatic climate control, wireless phone charging, and an 8-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and Amazon Alexa are all standard on the 2022 XLE. The second row is a pair of captain's chairs that slide forward for third-row access, and the third row folds flat into the floor when the cargo matters more than the seats.  Toyota Safety Sense 2.5+ is standard, and the XLE adds the blind spot monitor. The pre-collision system watches for pedestrians and cyclists and adds intersection support for left turns across traffic, full-speed dynamic radar cruise control follows traffic down to a stop and back up, lane departure alert with steering assist and lane tracing assist keep the vehicle centered on marked highways, and road sign assist and automatic high beams round it out. Blind spot monitor with rear cross-traffic alert, which the LE does not get, is standard on the XLE.  Blueprint is the deep navy that reads almost black in the shade and blue in the sun, and it is the color that made the Highlander stop looking like a rental. Over the black SofTex interior it is the combination that stays looking new. At 63,000 miles, this Highlander is past Toyota's 3-year/36,000-mile basic warranty on mileage, which is exactly what the Toyota Certified program is for: the 12-month/12,000-mile comprehensive warranty replaces it, and the 7-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty covers the engine and transmission described above; ask us for the in-service date and we will show you in writing what remains.  Toyota Certified Pre-Owned Every Toyota Certified Pre-Owned vehicle passes a 160-point inspection by factory-trained technicians and comes with a 12-month/12,000-mile comprehensive limited warranty from the date of purchase, a 7-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty from the original in-service date, 24/7 roadside assistance, and a CARFAX vehicle history report. Ask us for the in-service date and we will show you in writing exactly how much coverage you are getting.  The Beaver 30-Day Exchange Take it home for a month. description: BRAUNABILITY WHEELCHAIR ACCESSIBLE PACIFICA WITH POWER FOLD OUT RAMP  You already know the routine you are trying to get out of. Somebody folds the chair, somebody else lifts it, everybody gets rained on in the parking lot, and a twenty minute errand turns into an ordeal. This van ends that. Pull up, open the passenger side sliding door, and the power fold out ramp lays itself down on the pavement. The rider goes up the ramp and into the open center bay on the lowered floor, gets buckled to the mounts set into that floor, and you are on your way to the appointment in Richland or out the 240 like it is any other minivan. From behind the wheel, that is exactly what it is.  That is the point of a BraunAbility conversion. BraunAbility does not bolt a lift into the back of a stock van. The floor is cut down and rebuilt so there is real head room and a flat surface to roll across, the structure is engineered around the opening, and the ramp is built into the vehicle instead of hanging off the bumper. This one keeps the factory front buckets and the third row split bench, which reclines and folds, so the whole family still rides together. The second row position is where the chair goes.  Look at what one of these costs new before you look at the price on this one. The mobility conversion by itself carries a suggested price around $40,750 on a new build, which puts a brand new BraunAbility Pacifica in the neighborhood of $88,685 before tax and license. All of that engineering is done, paid for, and sitting on our lot at a used minivan number with 43,148 miles on the odometer.  It is a Touring L with Quick Order Package 27L. Uconnect 5 on a 10.1 inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, SiriusXM, six speakers and integrated active noise cancellation that keeps the cabin quiet on a long haul to Spokane or Yakima. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel for January mornings. Front dual zone climate with separate rear air conditioning, so nobody in the back is cooking. Power and memory on the driver seat, power liftgate, ParkView rear back up camera, front fog lights, automatic headlights, rain sensing wipers, rear wiper, heated mirrors, auto dimming rear view mirror, garage door transmitter, roof rack, Touring suspension and 17 inch aluminum wheels. Perforated leather trim seating in black, Bright White Clearcoat outside. The 3.6 liter V6 and the nine speed automatic are the combination Pacifica families already know.  The history report on this one is clean. No accidents or damage reported, clean title, no total loss, no odometer rollback, and all damage brands clear.  This one is Archibald Certified. It passed our 100-point inspection and is backed by our 3 Month/3,000 Mile Limited Warranty covering engine, transmission and transfer case, and differential components. description: Beaver Direct Certified | 2022 Subaru Ascent Touring | The Top-Trim Ascent with DriverFocus, the Camera That Watches the Driver Instead of the Road | 63,886 Miles 63,886 Miles | Autumn Green Metallic over Java Brown Perforated Leather | Stock #T472055B | Beaver Direct Certified | Touring Trim with Harman Kardon Audio, Panoramic Moonroof, and Second-Row Captain's Chairs  Every driver-assistance system on the market watches the road. The Subaru Ascent Touring is one of the few three-row SUVs in its price range that also watches the driver. DriverFocus, exclusive to the Touring trim, is an infrared camera in the dash that reads where your eyes are pointed. Look at your phone for too long and it chimes. Start to nod off on a late drive back from Lake Lanier and it warns you before EyeSight has to brake for something. It also recognizes up to five drivers by face and moves the seat, mirrors, and climate settings to their presets the moment they sit down. On a family vehicle that gets shared, this 2022 Ascent Touring is the one that already knows who is driving.  Touring is the top of the Ascent line, and the equipment shows it. Java Brown perforated leather with heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row captain's chairs, a heated steering wheel, a panoramic power moonroof, a 14-speaker Harman Kardon audio system, an 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a Wi-Fi hotspot, 20-inch wheels, a power rear gate, and a Smart Rear View Mirror that switches to a camera feed when the cargo hold or the third row is full are all standard on the Touring. Seating is seven: two captain's chairs in the second row with a walk-through to the third. This one adds the factory accessories on the build line: an auto-dimming exterior mirror with approach lighting, a third-row sunshade, splash guards, the LED map and reading light upgrade kit, and all-weather floor liners.  The powertrain is the 2.4-liter turbocharged boxer four with 260 horsepower and 277 pound-feet of torque, paired with Subaru's Lineartronic CVT and Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive. Every Ascent is all-wheel drive from the factory, with 8.7 inches of ground clearance, X-Mode with hill descent control for gravel roads and boat ramps, and a 5,000-pound tow rating with trailer stability assist. Torque arrives low in the rev range, which is what a loaded three-row SUV needs pulling onto GA-400.  EyeSight is standard, and the Touring adds the extras. Pre-collision braking with pedestrian detection, adaptive cruise control with lane centering that holds the lane and the gap in stop-and-go traffic, lane departure and sway warning, lane keep assist, blind-spot detection with rear cross-traffic alert, reverse automatic braking, a front-view monitor for blind intersections, and steering-responsive LED headlights that turn with the wheel are all on this vehicle.  Autumn Green Metallic is a deep forest green that Subaru offers on very few vehicles, and over the Java Brown leather it is the most distinctive color combination in the Ascent lineup, the one that looks like it belongs at a trailhead rather than a mall. At 63,886 miles, this Ascent is past Subaru's 3-year/36,000-mile basic and 5-year/60,000-mile powertrain warranties on mileage. That is why it is sold as Beaver Direct Certified with the Platinum warranty rather than as-is, and why the price on a top-trim Ascent looks the way it does.  Beaver Direct Certified Every Beaver Direct Certified vehicle comes with the Platinum 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty, a $1,395 value, included in the price. Before it reached the lot this Ascent went through reconditioning and a multi-point inspection, and we will show you the inspection report. Subaru's factory warranties have run out on mileage on this vehicle, so treat the Platinum warranty as the coverage; ask us and we will show you the terms in writing.  The Beaver 30-Day Exchange Take it home for a month. Let DriverFocus learn the family, fill both back rows, run the ventilated seats on a hot afternoon, and put it in X-Mode on a gravel road. If it is not the right vehicle, bring it back within 30 days and exchange it for one that is.  Come see it. This 2022 Subaru Ascent Touring, Stock #T472055B, is on the ground now at Beaver Toyota of Cumming. description: Beaver Direct Certified | 2022 Hyundai Santa Fe SEL | The Beige Interior That Is Allowed to Be Beige  Stain-Resistant Cloth, Roof Rack Cross Bars, and Stop-and-Go Cruise | 82,400 Miles 82,400 Miles | Quartz White over Beige YES Essentials Cloth | Stock #T478846A | Beaver Direct Certified  Everybody wants a light interior and almost nobody orders one, for the same reason: the first coffee, the first kid, the first wet dog. Hyundai solved that on this Santa Fe with a fabric it calls YES Essentials  a stain-resistant, odor-resistant, anti-static cloth engineered so that spills bead up and wipe off rather than soaking in, and the smell of a soccer bag does not settle into the seats. That is what makes the beige possible. And beige is the color you want in a Georgia July: it stays dramatically cooler in the sun than black, it hides dust that dark fabric shows instantly, and it makes the cabin feel a size larger. Over Quartz White, it is the combination that looks like a decision rather than a default, on a vehicle where most people default.  The Santa Fe is the two-row for people who wanted the Palisade's cabin without the third row. The wide, quiet interior, the tall windows, and a back seat with real legroom, in a footprint that still fits a Halcyon parking space. The original owner added the accessories people mean to buy and never do: roof rack cross bars for the kayak or the cargo box, mudguards, carpeted floor mats, a cargo tray for the wet things, and a first-aid kit.  The driver-assist content is the good version. Smart Cruise Control with stop-and-go holds your following distance on GA-400, brings the vehicle to a complete stop when traffic stops, and resumes on its own when it moves  in a rolling backup that removes the single most tiring part of the drive.
